cc:Work.dc:title: Mikros native64 server benchmarks
cc:Work.dc:description: Measured completed v3 server experiments. N30: eight measured runs per variant; N24: independent ablation with sixteen measured runs. Main native allocations are fresh; reuse retains capacity after warmup. PIOP reductions only. Source fingerprint 1044d29674c3db363e71c98a028d2a089272235e9924e6ca2420610787c2999d. Inputs: v3/results/comparison-64t.json, v3/results/profile-64t.json, v3/ablation/comparison-64t.json.
